subject: SuperAgers' memory advantage was not explained by their Alzheimer's genes
script: From Agewell Brief: SuperAgers' memory advantage was not explained by their Alzheimer's genes. A new study finds that people in their 80s and 90s with exceptional memory don't carry fewer Alzheimer's-related genes. The search for what protects them continues. Forgetting names or where you left your keys can feel like an inevitable part of aging. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
